value.rationale: A complete, natural stochastic geodesic-escape graph classification, valid in every dimension for every independent uniform-azimuth sampling law, with exact no-escape/variance formulas and a sharp nontrivial Poisson onset. Its geometric reduction and structural invariance are the contribution; it is not claimed that classical interval-range statistics or Poisson convergence are themselves new. This gives a testable benchmark for loss of geodesic convexity in reflex spherical sectors.
